verdict.rationale: SerpApi scrapes live Google and Google News result pages through a real-time JSON API, with a cache that expires after 1h, so results are fresh. It also accepts any regular Google search operator. However, the pack never documents an explicit date-range or recency parameter, and freshness comes from live scraping rather than an index of its own. missing for 10: documented date-range/recency filter parameters (e.g. time-bounded search options), explicit evidence that operators like before:/after: work, independent or hands-on corroboration of result freshness.
